Night Has Come

밤이 되었습니다

K-Drama · Series · South Korea · 2023

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐∞/10

Overview

A class field trip turns into a nightmare when the students of Class 2-3 of Yooil High School become trapped inside a retreat center and are forced to play a real-life version of the Mafia Game. Every night, students receive roles such as Mafia, Doctor, Police, and Citizen, and if they fail to eliminate the correct person, someone dies for real. As suspicion, betrayal, and fear consume the class, friendships begin to crumble. While searching for the truth behind the deadly game, Yoon-seo slowly discovers that everything is connected to a tragic incident involving one of their classmates. The deeper they dig, the more horrifying the reality becomes.

My Review

One of the best thriller series I've ever watched. The Mafia Game was incredibly well-written. It wasn't just about guessing who the Mafia was—I actually had to use my brain throughout the entire series. Every episode kept me questioning everyone's role: the Mafia, the Doctor, the Police, and the Citizens. The suspense never stopped. The plot twist was absolutely insane. But... I hate the fucking ending. I was so irritated with Kim So-mi. She was unbelievably selfish and only cared about herself and Jun-hee. I honestly felt satisfied when she died. I also hated Jin Da-beom. He spent his whole life being bullied, yet once he gained power as the Mafia, he became exactly what he hated. He looked innocent on the outside but was the complete opposite inside—a real definition of an angel-faced devil. The biggest plot twist was discovering that Park Se-eun, Yoon-seo's best friend, had actually committed suicide in real life because of cyberbullying. The students weren't simply playing a game—they were trapped inside an endless simulation where every death, every fear, and every pain felt completely real. The parents of Se-eun created the game to make the students suffer for what happened to their daughter. I really thought everything was finally over after Yoon-seo won. Then she woke up. I thought they were finally free. But after everything those students had suffered—even dying countless times inside the game—the parents still refused to let them go. The father finally began listening to Yoon-seo, but the mother remained consumed by revenge and wanted them to continue suffering. One thing that kept bothering me was... Where were the adults? Where were the teachers? The police? The parents? How could nobody realize those students had disappeared? I seriously hope Season 2 happens because I need them to finally get the ending they deserve.

Favorite Scene/Part

• Every Mafia voting session where everyone desperately tried to figure out who was lying. • The constant mind games between the Mafia, Doctor, Police, and Citizens. • Yoon-seo slowly uncovering the truth behind the game. • The revelation, that Park Se-eun's parents created the deadly simulation. • Yoon-seo finally won the game - the first one. • The emotional sacrifice made so Yoon-seo could survive. • The shocking moment when Yoon-seo woke up believing everything was over, only to realize the nightmare wasn't truly finished.

Favorite Quote/Lines

"Voting has ended. [Name] is being executed."
